scope: Every rbxassetid reference under src was probed without authentication. Only confirmed unauthorized, not-found, or archived assets are listed.

interpretation.authentication_required: Inconclusive without credentials; excluded because some assets with this response still load in Studio.
interpretation.unauthorized: Roblox explicitly denied access; included as missing.
interpretation.not_found: Roblox reported that the asset does not exist; included as missing.
interpretation.archived: Roblox reported that the asset is archived; included as missing.
